description:
A software solution enabling PC-to-PC experiences using Thunderbolt technology and is supported on all Windows 11 Thunderbolt 4/5 enabled PCs.

A software solution enabling PC-to-PC experiences using Thunderbolt™ technology (A cable type best described as a merger of extra-high-speed USB, DisplayPort, and FireWire) and is supported on all Windows 11 Thunderbolt™ 4 or Thunderbolt™ 5 enabled PCs.
